name: Malteries Franco-Belges Société Anonyme
summary: Malteries Franco-Belges Société Anonyme engages in the malting business for brewing and distilling in France, European Union, and internationally. The company produces and sells malt and related malting products, as well as trades in barley. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Nogent-sur-Seine, France. Malteries Franco-Belges Société Anonyme operates as a subsidiary of Malteries Soufflet SAS.
